captureBlocker: NO_CAPTURE_PATH: `sim.sh run` launches the app with only -AppleLanguages/-AppleLocale. The fixture composition needs the `-scenario <id>` launch argument (LaunchMode.of, Debug only), and sim.sh has no option to pass it, so every sim.sh run opens the live composition. This screen is also not the launch screen (it needs a tab change or a push), and sim.sh captures only the screen shown after launch. No hand-made or XCUITest screenshot substitutes for a sim.sh run (VISUAL_VALIDATION.md). Needs: sim.sh --scenario (ORCH) and a launch route to this screen (front C), or an agreed capture path.
